flagship_project.name: Project OmniLedger-100K: Sub-Microsecond High-Throughput UPI Auto-Reversal & Real-Time Graph Fraud Detection Engine
flagship_project.pillar: Ultra-High Concurrency FinTech Core & Real-Time Graph Fraud Defense
flagship_project.strategic_thesis: PhonePe handles over 48% of India's UPI volume (~200M daily transactions). OmniLedger-100K scales transaction throughput to 100,000 TPS with automated sub-second dual-entry reconciliation, instant bank-failure reversals, and real-time graph neural network fraud blocking under 3ms.
flagship_project.tech_stack: Rust (Consensus Core), Neo4j / TigerGraph (Real-time Graph Fraud Mesh), Redis Enterprise Clustered (In-memory Balance Store), Cassandra / ScyllaDB, Envoy Service Mesh, Kafka Streams
flagship_project.kpis: Zero reconciliation lags; 0.0001% fraud dispute rate on 6.5B monthly transactions; 99.999% uptime during Diwali shopping spikes.
